fit_reason: Primary frontier coding model provider with native Claude Code compatibility, strong prompt caching, batch cancel, and programmatic Admin usage/rate-limit APIs.

programmable_control: Start: `POST https://{region}.ml.cloud.ibm.com/ml/v1/text/chat?version=2024-05-31`; Check: `GET /ml/v1/foundation_model_specs`; Stop: abort HTTP stream. Docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/watsonx-ai

name: DigitalOcean Gradient AI Platform
what_it_is: DigitalOcean's managed serverless inference and agent platform exposing OpenAI-compatible endpoints for open-weight and partner models.
programmable_control: Start: `POST https://inference.do-ai.run/v1/chat/completions`; Check: `GET /v1/models` or `doctl`; Stop: abort HTTP stream. Docs: https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/gradient-ai-platform/
usage_or_limits: DigitalOcean Billing API (`GET /v2/customers/my/balance`) and console usage
pricing_model: Pay-as-you-go per 1M tokens + GPU Droplets; promotional credits for new DigitalOcean accounts

what_it_is: Heroku add-on providing OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible managed inference for Claude, Nova, and open models provisioned via `heroku ai`.
programmable_control: Provision: `heroku ai:models:create <model> -a <app>`; Call: `POST $INFERENCE_URL/v1/chat/completions` (or `/v1/messages`); Check: `heroku ai:models:info`; Stop: `heroku ai:models:destroy` or abort stream. Docs: https://devcenter.heroku.com/articles/heroku-inference

name: Vultr Serverless Inference
what_it_is: Low-cost OpenAI-compatible serverless inference API running open-weight LLMs on Vultr's NVIDIA and AMD GPU fleet.
programmable_control: Start: `POST https://api.vultrinference.com/v1/chat/completions`; Check: `GET /v1/models`; Stop: abort HTTP stream. Docs: https://docs.vultr.com/vultr-serverless-inference

fit_reason: Simple drop-in OpenAI-compatible serverless open-weight inference with transparent Vultr billing.

programmable_control: Start: `POST https://api.morphllm.com/v1/chat/completions` with `<code_to_edit>` / `<update>` tags; Check: `GET /v1/models`; Stop: abort HTTP stream. Docs: https://docs.morphllm.com/
usage_or_limits: Dashboard usage/billing; programmatic balance endpoint unverified
pricing_model: Pay-as-you-go per 1M tokens; starter/trial tier available (exact free cap unverified)

name: Relace (Instant Apply & Code Rerank)
what_it_is: High-throughput code-patching (`relace-apply-3` at ~10,000 tok/s) and repository code-reranking API purpose-built for coding agents.
programmable_control: Start: `POST https://instantapply.endpoint.relace.run/v1/code/apply` (or OpenAI-compatible via OpenRouter/AIML API) and `/v1/code/rerank`; Check: HTTP response; Stop: abort HTTP request. Docs: https://docs.relace.ai/
usage_or_limits: Dashboard usage/billing; programmatic balance endpoint unverified
pricing_model: Pay-as-you-go per 1M tokens (cuts full-file rewrite cost/latency >3x); free tier unverified
fit_reason: Proven at trillion-token scale for coding agents (Instant Apply + repo rerank), complementing primary reasoning models.

name: Ollama (Local & Ollama Cloud)
what_it_is: De facto local model runtime (and hosted Ollama Cloud) exposing native, OpenAI-compatible, and Anthropic-compatible APIs plus `ollama launch`.
open_source: yes (MIT for `ollama/ollama`; Ollama Cloud service proprietary)
programmable_control: Start: `ollama serve` / `ollama run <model>` / `ollama launch <tool>`, Call: `POST http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/messages`, `/api/chat` (Cloud: `https://ollama.com`); Check: `ollama ps`, `GET /api/ps`, `GET /api/tags`; Stop: `ollama stop <model>` or abort stream. Docs: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/api.md
auth_method: Local: none (localhost); Ollama Cloud: API key (`Authorization: Bearer <OLLAMA_API_KEY>`)
usage_or_limits: Local: `GET /api/ps` (loaded models & VRAM usage); Cloud: subscription credit pools & concurrent-request limits (3 on PAYG/Pro, 10 on Max/Team)
pricing_model: Local: $0 free & MIT; Ollama Cloud: PAYG ($0 base + per-token credits), Pro $20/mo ($60 credits), Max $100/mo ($300 credits), Team $500/mo ($1,000 shared credits)
os_platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon/Intel), Linux (NVIDIA/AMD/CPU), Windows + Ollama Cloud
fit_reason: Universal local model runtime with MIT license, native OpenAI AND Anthropic `/v1/messages` compatibility, `ollama stop`, and optional Ollama Cloud spillover.

name: LM Studio (`lms` CLI & `llmster` Headless Daemon)
what_it_is: Desktop and headless (`llmster`) local model runtime supporting llama.cpp and Apple MLX with JIT model loading and an OpenAI-compatible server.
open_source: partial (`lms` CLI and JS/Python SDKs are MIT; LM Studio desktop & `llmster` core are proprietary freeware)
programmable_control: Start: `lms daemon up` / `lms server start` / `lms load <model>`, Call: `POST http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions`; Check: `lms ps`, `lms ls`, `GET /v1/models`; Stop: `lms unload <model>` / `lms server stop` / `lms daemon down`. Docs: https://lmstudio.ai/docs/cli
auth_method: Local: none (optional local token); optional LM Link / Bionic cloud account
usage_or_limits: Local: `lms ps` (loaded models & memory) and `lms log`; Bionic cloud quotas in account
pricing_model: Local desktop, `lms`, and `llmster` free for personal and commercial/work use ($0); optional Bionic+ ($20/mo) and Pro ($100/mo) cloud model tiers
fit_reason: Free commercial local runtime with clean `lms` CLI lifecycle (`daemon up`, `load`, `ps`, `unload`, `server stop`), JIT loading, and MLX + GGUF support.

name: vLLM (`vllm serve`)
what_it_is: Industry-standard open-source high-throughput GPU inference engine with PagedAttention, OpenAI Chat/Responses, and Anthropic Messages compatibility.
programmable_control: Start: `vllm serve <model> --port 8000`; Call: `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/responses`, `/v1/messages`; Check: `GET /health`, `GET /v1/models`, `GET /metrics`; Stop: SIGTERM/kill process or abort stream. auth_method: Optional static `--api-key` Bearer token (or upstream reverse proxy auth)
usage_or_limits: Prometheus endpoint `GET /metrics` (KV-cache utilization, running/waiting requests, TTFT, throughput)
pricing_model: Free & open source (Apache-2.0); pay only for your own GPU compute
os_platforms: Linux (NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, Intel Gaudi/XPU, TPU, AWS Trainium/Inferentia, CPU)
fit_reason: Gold-standard self-hosted GPU serving engine with both OpenAI and Anthropic `/v1/messages` APIs and rich Prometheus telemetry.

name: SGLang (`sglang.launch_server`)
what_it_is: High-performance open-source GPU serving engine with RadixAttention automatic prefix-cache reuse, OpenAI, and Anthropic Messages APIs.
programmable_control: Start: `python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <model> --port 30000`; Call: `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/messages`; Check: `GET /health`, `GET /get_model_info`, `GET /metrics`; Stop: SIGTERM/kill process or abort stream. usage_or_limits: Prometheus `GET /metrics` (RadixAttention cache hit rate, queue depth, throughput)
pricing_model: Free & open source (Apache-2.0); pay only for your own GPU compute
os_platforms: Linux (NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm, Intel, CPU)
fit_reason: RadixAttention automatic prefix caching is tailor-made for multi-turn coding-agent fleets, with native OpenAI and Anthropic `/v1/messages` APIs.

what_it_is: Lightweight, dependency-free C/C++ local inference engine and HTTP server (`llama-server`) for GGUF models across CPU, Metal, CUDA, Vulkan, and ROCm.
programmable_control: Start: `llama-server -m <model.gguf> --port 8080` (or `-hf <repo>`); Call: `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `/infill` (FIM); Check: `GET /health`, `GET /props`, `GET /slots`, `GET /metrics`; Stop: SIGTERM/kill process or abort stream. pricing_model: Free & open source (MIT)
os_platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon Metal/Intel), Linux, Windows, BSD (CPU, CUDA, Vulkan, ROCm, SYCL)
fit_reason: Zero-dependency MIT local engine running on every OS/GPU/CPU with OpenAI API, FIM `/infill`, and slot-level observability.

usage_or_limits: None (per-response token usage JSON only)
pricing_model: Free & open source (MIT)
fit_reason: Fastest local inference on Apple Silicon Macs with prompt caching and zero-config OpenAI-compatible server.

pricing_model: Apache-2.0 runtime ($0); Docker Desktop free for personal/small business, paid subscription for large enterprises

fit_reason: Clean container-native model lifecycle (`docker model`) with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama wire compatibility out of the box.
